known.via: English Wikipedia "Norte de Almería" (a wine place on Wikidata)

blurb.text: An Andalusian vino de la tierra covering four municipalities in northern Almería: Chirivel, María, Vélez-Blanco and Vélez-Rubio. It sits one step below the DO level and gained its status in 2008.
